text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's revenues totalled 560.8 million dinars last year, up 6.5 percent over 1994 revenues, said a Bahrain Monetary Agency report released on Tuesday.
- A Bahraini official said GCC Secretary General Jameel al-Hujailan visited Bahrain for no other reason than to inform Manama of the final results of the GCC foreign ministers' meeting in Doha.
